easy-plots.core.event-received.semantic_mapping: Canonical event trigger starts evaluation from the durable authenticated event envelope.

easy-plots.core.schedule-due.semantic_mapping: Verified due records produce canonical schedule-due input for subscribed published graphs.
easy-plots.core.schedule-due.deviation_or_limit: Only due records selected through the bounded coordinator are authoritative; clock movement alone does not apply effects.

easy-plots.core.manual-trigger.semantic_mapping: Explicit GM manual ingress produces a canonical manual event for the specialized trigger.
easy-plots.core.manual-trigger.deviation_or_limit: Submitting the manual event does not approve downstream effect proposals.

easy-plots.core.evaluate-condition.semantic_mapping: Event data extraction and typed comparison compose a protected boolean value.
easy-plots.core.evaluate-condition.deviation_or_limit: Two authored nodes replace the candidate's single event-to-boolean node; field/type choices are explicit.

easy-plots.core.branch-exclusive.semantic_mapping: A typed predicate feeds core.branch.data and selects exactly one event path.
easy-plots.core.branch-exclusive.deviation_or_limit: The input also needs the event carrier; core.branch.condition separately evaluates configured predicates.

easy-plots.core.branch-parallel.semantic_mapping: core.branch.parallel fans the event carrier across eligible connected paths.
easy-plots.core.branch-parallel.deviation_or_limit: The catalog's flow[] is represented by multiple event edges; ordering and deduplication require evaluator tests, not port-count equivalence.

easy-plots.core.join.semantic_mapping: core.flow.join validates a configured rendezvous over event-flow arrivals.
easy-plots.core.join.deviation_or_limit: One declared event input represents configured incoming edges; the proposed flow[] interface is not a literal matching port.

easy-plots.core.subgraph-call.semantic_mapping: Published subgraph calls include pure typed calls, event calls and core.subgraph.mixed with typed parameters/exports and effect proposals.
easy-plots.core.subgraph-call.deviation_or_limit: Parameters, published versions, arguments and revisions are pinned; composition replaces the catalog's generic typed[] interface.

easy-plots.core.event-filter.semantic_mapping: core.event.filter forwards only matching canonical event envelopes.
easy-plots.core.event-filter.deviation_or_limit: Filtering is configured on the node and never authenticates an untrusted envelope by itself.

easy-plots.core.state-read.semantic_mapping: core.state.value reads an entity-keyed authoritative state into an explicitly configured typed output with revision evidence.
easy-plots.core.state-read.deviation_or_limit: core.state.read is a separate comparison/branch node; it must not be substituted for arbitrary value output.

easy-plots.core.state-proposal.semantic_mapping: core.effect.proposal stages an immutable state/effect intent in durable GM review.
easy-plots.core.state-proposal.deviation_or_limit: Intent is a protected review record, not a graph output capability; opening or evaluating never applies it.

easy-plots.core.approval-gate.semantic_mapping: GM decide and execute operate on a persisted proposal with independent approval and execution checks.
easy-plots.core.approval-gate.deviation_or_limit: No graph approval token is emitted; approval is a server-validated review state that cannot be wired as ordinary data.

easy-plots.core.rate-budget-gate.semantic_mapping: Runtime work budgets bound evaluation and protect against unbounded execution.
easy-plots.core.rate-budget-gate.deviation_or_limit: A configured per-key authored rate gate corresponding to the candidate interface is not established by global budgets.

easy-plots.core.publish-view.semantic_mapping: Reviewed projection/publication workflows select allowlisted data and authorized recipients before protected delivery.
easy-plots.core.publish-view.deviation_or_limit: There is no generic arbitrary approved-data-to-view node; each publication family has a bounded reviewed contract.

easy-plots.core.effect-intent.semantic_mapping: DurableProposalReview executes approved intents through EffectCoordinator; verified original operations may explicitly emit a continuation event.
easy-plots.core.effect-intent.deviation_or_limit: Operations live in journals, not graph data ports; continuation requires a separate approved gateway step and fresh target proposals.

easy-plots.quests.qualify-milestone.deviation_or_limit: The milestone is persisted through the approved provider; it is not exposed as an arbitrary milestone data output.
